item.title: Stephen Miller named White House Chief of Staff
item.description: Following historic Republican losses in the midterm elections, Donald Trump has replaced his chief of staff, Susie Wiles, with her deputy Stephen Miller, the architect of his administration’s immigration crackdown. Wiles had been seen by some as a stabilising force in the White House, but with Democrats now controlling both chambers of Congress, Trump is reportedly seeking a more aggressive approach to pushing his agenda. Caroline Baum reports. Publicado también por: The Hindu - International. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Ousted Paraguay president under house arrest after bank collapse
item.description: Paraguayan authorities placed ousted president Santiago Peña under house arrest on Friday, shortly after the Senate unanimously removed him from office over a massive banking crisis that locked nearly half of Paraguayans out of their savings. Peña offered his resignation over the scandal, but lawmakers pressed ahead with impeachment proceedings that stripped him of political immunity. item.title: Informe desde Asunción: manifestantes celebran la destitución de Santiago Peña en Paraguay
item.description: La destitución de Santiago Peña desató escenas de celebración en las calles de Paraguay. Tras días de protestas y creciente presión ciudadana por la crisis vinculada a Ueno Bank, manifestantes salieron a las calles para exigir un juicio político al ahora expresidente. El Senado lo declaró culpable por "mal desempeño de funciones" y lo apartó del cargo. El informe es de nuestra corresponsal Flavia Borja Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Israel espera decisión de Herzog: Eisenkot dice tener ventaja para formar gobierno
item.description: El presidente de Israel, Isaac Herzog, concluyó las consultas con los partidos y anunció que este domingo designará al candidato encargado de formar gobierno. Quien reciba el mandato tendrá 28 días, prorrogables por otros 14, para construir una coalición. Si fracasa, el encargo pasará a otro aspirante y, de no lograrse una mayoría, el país podría volver a las urnas. Mientras tanto, Gadi Eisenkot llega fortalecido tras recibir el respaldo de 67 diputados y asegura que existe una mayoría a su favor. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Trump axes chief of staff Susie Wiles for Stephen Miller after resounding midterms defeat
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Friday that Stephen Miller would replace Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff, elevating a long-time loyalist and architect of his immigration crackdown days after Republicans lost control of Congress. Miller, currently a deputy chief of staff, will take over on Monday. Wiles will move to Trump’s political operation, the president said in a post on social media. The change puts one of Trump’s staunchest ideological allies in charge of the White House staff... Publicado también por: The Hindu - International, South China Morning Post. Fuente: The Independent - World.
